name: Iconic Destinations
description: A premium collection of iconic cities, landmarks, heritage sites and natural destinations. Each design uses its own colour palette so the artwork can preserve the character and atmosphere of the place.
description_en: A premium collection of iconic cities, landmarks, heritage sites and natural destinations. Each design uses its own colour palette so the artwork can preserve the character and atmosphere of the place.
description_es: Colección premium de ciudades, monumentos, lugares históricos y destinos naturales emblemáticos. Cada diseño utiliza su propia paleta para conservar el carácter y la atmósfera de cada lugar.

canvas_rules.detail_policy: Prefer one strong focal landmark and readable silhouettes over micro-detail.

generation.purpose: Iconic Destinations reusable cross-stitch lifestyle mockup.
generation.frame_requirement: Keep the central wooden frame empty; renderer inserts the exact vector stitch pattern.
generation.post_generation_measurement: Calibrated to the detected 256×256 central frame opening: x=75, y=27, width=122, height=149. Zero padding; centered; cover fit so no white border remains.

design_reference.purpose: Use the approved 10 six-panel concept boards as visual direction when creating the final individual source images.
design_reference.final_source_requirement: Create each destination as an individual full-size source before pattern conversion; do not crop the six-panel boards into production artwork.
design_reference.target: 100x120 master-grid composition, four chart pages, palette chosen independently for each design.
